blogs.title: Unleashing Math Power: How DeepSeekMath’s 120B Web Corpus Turns the Internet Into a Knowledge Base
blogs.description: This post walks readers through the ingenious data‑collection pipeline that turned Common Crawl into a 120‑billion‑token “math corpus.” It explains the fastText selector, the iterative cleaning loop, benchmark de‑contamination, and why a multilingual web source beats traditional arXiv‑centric datasets.

blogs.title: Code Before Math: The Hidden Link Between Programming and Problem‑Solving in LLMs
blogs.description: Many researchers think code training only improves coding, but DeepSeekMath shows otherwise. The article demystifies the two‑stage vs one‑stage training experiments, revealing how code tokens sharpen reasoning with and without tools, and why they can even prevent catastrophic forgetting.

blogs.title: Meet GRPO: The Lightweight Reinforcement Learning Switch That Gives 7B Models a GPT‑4 Edge
blogs.description: Repackage the heavy PPO into GRPO—no critic, group‑relative baselines, and built‑in KL regularisation. The blog illustrates how GRPO cuts memory demands while pushing a 7B model from 46% to 51% on MATH, and how it shines on out‑of‑domain benchmarks.

blogs.title: From Chain‑of‑Thought to Tool‑Integrated Reasoning: Instruction‑Tuning Secrets Behind DeepSeekMath’s Success
blogs.description: Dive into the curated instruction set of 776k CoT, PoT, and tool‑integrated examples that form the backbone of DeepSeekMath-Instruct. The post explains how multilingual problem sets and diverse solution styles elevate performance across English and Chinese math tests.

blogs.title: Beyond Numbers: Why Web Pages Beat ArXiv for Mathematical LLM Pre‑Training
blogs.description: A data scientist’s exploration of why a web‑based math corpus outperforms arXiv papers despite their technical depth. The piece contrasts preprocessing pipelines (MathPile vs RedPajama), touches on token quality, and hints at future hybrid strategies.
